extras: Desktop only. Conflicts with the Smart List Input plugin, which rewrites 1、 into 1.; disable it if installed. Produces plain-text numbering, not Markdown lists. No network or telemetry. The directory shows the English name because Obsidian requires Basic Latin in manifest.json.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown turns Chinese-style numbered lines into 1. lists, so writers cannot keep native Chinese numbering formats.
summary: Numbering tool for writing Chinese-style outlines (一、 1、 1.1、) with four presets, Enter to continue and Tab to change level.
